findings.class: PROPOSAL - shared code the lane may not edit
findings.title: A factuality finding can never be refuted by a cited inherited_unit fact's literal text, even when the reviewed unit cites one whose value is the upstream README's own documentation of the exact claim.
findings.detail: The surviving finding F04 says the candidate's claim ('Binary glTF export (binaryMode: true) currently fails for any non-empty mesh') is unverified, citing only example:007 (a compile-checked example showing binaryMode=false working) as its own evidence. But the content unit under review (scope_limitations, slot limitation:2) cites TWO facts: example:007 AND inherited_unit:046.paragraph. The latter is SUPPORTED, sourced from the original repository's own upstream README at lines 261-264, and its value is 'Binary glTF (.glb, binaryMode = true) currently throws a RangeError for any non-empty mesh - see Scope and limitations. Use the JSON/ASCII form (binaryMode = false, the default) shown above until that is fixed upstream.' - the library author's own documented bug, which an earlier repair round (R02) had already softened from 'throws a RangeError' to 'fails' while still citing inherited_unit:046.paragraph. cited_fact_defect builds product = [fact for fact in cited if fact.kind != "inherited_unit"] from the FINDING's own fact_ids before the literal-value check runs, so even a finding that had cited inherited_unit:046.paragraph directly would have that citation discarded before it could refute anything - the function structurally cannot credit any inherited_unit fact. No other refutation function (absence_defect, rendered_defect, renderer_owned_defect, scope_defect) engages the reviewed UNIT's own second citation either; none asks whether any fact the candidate actually cited (as opposed to what the finding itself cites) already supports the quote. Proposed, smallest first: drop the inherited_unit exclusion in cited_fact_defect's product list; or, more broadly, add a refutation that checks the reviewed unit's full fact_ids for a SUPPORTED inherited_unit whose value contains the quote's substance.
